name: LQS - Qualification: decide next step
description: Reads only. In: conversation_id, intent. Out: { ok, action, slot_key, variant, question_text, choices_json, chosen_slot_utc }. Pure code implementation of the supervisor ladder decision rules. No AI node. Returns no_slot_definitions when the market has no slots.

parameters.query: select c.id as conversation_id, c.status as conversation_status, c.deal_type as deal_type, c.questions_asked as questions_asked, c.language as language, c.booking_declines as declines, l.full_name as lead_full_name, m.thresholds as thresholds, m.currency as currency, m.disclaimers as lines, (select coalesce(json_agg(sd2), '[]'::json) from (select sd.slot_key, sd.tier, sd.priority, sd.required, sd.value_type, sd.question_open, sd.question_goal, sd.question_choices, sd.condition, sd.extraction_hint from lqs.slot_definitions sd where sd.market_id = c.market_id and sd.deal_type = c.deal_type and sd.active order by sd.priority) sd2) as slot_definitions, (select coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('slot_key', q.slot_key, 'value', q.value, 'state', q.state, 'attempts', q.attempts, 'previous_values', q.previous_values)), '[]'::json) from lqs.qualification q where q.conversation_id = c.id) as qualification, (select row_to_json(b) from (select bk.id, bk.status, bk.offered_slots from lqs.bookings bk where bk.conversation_id = c.id order by bk.created_at desc limit 1) b) as latest_booking, (select count(*) from lqs.bookings bk where bk.conversation_id = c.id)::int as offers_made, (select count(*) from lqs.messages mm where mm.conversation_id = c.id and mm.direction = 'outbound' and mm.created_at > coalesce((select bk2.created_at from lqs.bookings bk2 where bk2.conversation_id = c.id and bk2.status = 'offered' order by bk2.created_at desc limit 1), now()))::int as outbound_since_offer, (select mm.body from lqs.messages mm where mm.conversation_id = c.id and mm.direction = 'inbound' order by mm.created_at desc limit 1) as last_inbound_text from lqs.conversations c join lqs.leads l on l.id = c.lead_id join lqs.markets m on m.id = c.market_id where c.id = $1::uuid;
